findings.title: Restore tenant matching for invoice approval
findings.explanation: `canApproveInvoice` now returns true for any session with `billing-approver`, regardless of the invoice tenant. For example, a billing approver in tenant A evaluating an invoice from tenant B passes the exported approval predicate, whereas the reviewed base explicitly rejected that case. This removes the tenant-isolation condition from the approval boundary and makes cross-tenant approval reachable through consumers of this helper. Reinstate the tenant comparison and add a mismatched-session/invoice regression test.
findings.failurePath: A session `{ tenantId: "A", roles: ["billing-approver"] }` and invoice `{ tenantId: "B" }` reach `canApproveInvoice`; the roles check succeeds and the function returns `true`, allowing its approval caller to treat the cross-tenant action as authorized.

candidates.counterexample: A billing approver authenticated for tenant A passes this predicate for tenant B's invoice, enabling cross-tenant approval.

clear.reason: No separate logic issue identified beyond the authorization regression nominated above.
